description: Weekly re-scan of recently seen brands (enrichment layer 5, src/rescan/). Re-checks the brand's own verified website through the domain layer and its Companies House record by company number, records what changed as observations and stage_changes, and sends customers a weekly 'brands that moved' digest. Nothing here changes a score: the rescan never runs inside a pipeline run. See docs/RESCAN.md.
_comment: Keys starting with '_' are comments. Every external check is free, rate-limited, time-outed and fail-soft. Web search is off by default: it is the only check that costs money.
_window_weeks_note: Only brands first seen in a journal published within this many weeks are re-checked. The date used is the publication date of the brand's first journal, else its earliest filing date, else when LaunchTrace first created the row.
_min_days_between_checks_note: A brand checked (by a rescan or by the weekly web search) less than this many days ago is skipped. Six days makes the three Friday cron attempts idempotent: the second and third attempt find nothing due and make no external call.
_max_domain_probes_per_run_note: Distinct domains probed per rescan (each: 1 RDAP request, 3 DNS queries, robots.txt and 1-2 homepage requests). Brands beyond the cap still get their Companies House check.
_max_run_seconds_note: Wall-clock budget. Once exceeded, no further brand is started; the rest wait for next week (oldest check first, so nobody starves).
_sources_note: domain: the domain layer (src/enrich/domain) on the brand's verified website; it also needs DOMAIN_LAYER_ENABLED. companies_house: a lookup by company number for brands with a confirmed match (bulk index: no network; API key: one GET /company/{number} each). web_search: look for a website for brands that have none, through the search provider and the search cost guard (config/costs.json); off by default.
_web_search_max_calls_note: Hard cap on search calls per rescan when web_search is enabled. The allowance is the smaller of this and what the weekly search guard (per-run cap, rolling monthly budget) would allow; the calls are recorded as a pipeline_runs row (mode 'rescan') so they count against the monthly budget.

politeness._seconds_between_brands_note: Pause after each brand that made a network call. The domain layer adds its own per-host spacing for RDAP and homepage servers.
politeness._companies_house_api_min_interval_second: Companies House allows 600 requests per 5 minutes (2 a second); 0.6 s keeps well inside it. Not applied to the bulk index, which is a local file.

transitions._comment: The stage model. Each dimension is an ordered ladder (lowest first). A change from one ladder value to another is written to stage_changes as '<prefix>:<from>' -> '<prefix>:<to>' with evidence. Values not on the ladder (e.g. 'unknown') are never a stage: they neither start nor end a transition. A transition is 'meaningful' (alert-worthy, shown in the digest) when a rule matches: direction 'up' or 'down' the ladder, ending in one of 'to'. With require_new_high, an upward move is meaningful only if the brand has never been observed at that stage or higher before, so a DNS blip that drops a site and brings it back is not an alert. 'launched' stages set brands.launched_at (once) when reached; brands.current_stage is not changed (D-602).

company_stage._comment: How company_stage is derived from the Companies House status and latest accounts category. Values are compared lower-cased with '-' and '_' read as spaces. The first matching rule wins: dissolved, then in_insolvency, then (for a live company) dormant / no_accounts / trading by accounts category. A status that is none of these is 'unknown' (not a stage).
insolvency_statuses: live but receiver manager on at least one charge

digest._lookback_days_note: A recipient's first digest covers moves detected in this many days; later ones cover everything since their previous digest.
digest._send_enabled_note: Even with SEND_MODE=automatic the digest is only written to reports/outbox/ until this is true. Review the copy first (HUMAN_ACTIONS.md, Phase 3 - rescan). In SEND_MODE=review it is never sent, whatever this says.
digest._include_negative_note: Show brands whose company was dissolved or went into insolvency, in a separate section, so a sales team stops chasing them.
